name: The Watchtower of Forbidden City
description: The turret of the Forbidden City is said to be inspired by a grasshopper cage. They are located at the four corners of the Forbidden City. Together with the city walls and moats, they are part of the palace's defense facilities. Each turret has nine beams, eighteen columns, and 72 ridges. The overall structure is compact. The combination of red and gold highlights the elegance and elegance of the turrets in the Forbidden City. The design of the turret is harmonious in proportion, complex and precise in size and structure, and unique. The eaves are beautiful and the shape is exquisite and unique, so it has become the symbol of the Forbidden City.
